g.title:
'$'''cat <<'''EOF''' > /tmp/dynamic.sh
#!/bin/bash
echo "Sourced dynamic script"
( ( echo "Nested in sourced" & ) )
declare -a local_arr=(a b c)
for val in "${local_arr[@]}", do
 echo "Sourced loop: $val"
done
EOF
' (1,132 us, 0.23%)
'select opt in a b quit' (108 us, 0.02%)
'trap '\''echo "TERM trap", ( eval "echo eval in trap" )'\'' TERM' (20,745 us, 4.30%)
'trap '\''echo "EXIT trap triggered", ( ( sleep 1 & ) & wait )'\'' EXIT' (21,458 us, 4.44%)
'@TRAP (USR1): echo "USR1 trap"\, ( ( echo "Nested in USR1" & ) )' (5,311 us, 1.10%)
'@TRAP (USR1): echo "USR1 trap"\, ( ( echo "Nested in USR1" & ) )' (134 us, 0.03%)

'$'''eval '''
 echo "Outer eval"
 (
 echo "Inner eval subshell"
 ( echo "Deeper eval bg" & )
 )
 '''' (90 us, 0.02%)
'trap '\''echo "USR1 trap", ( ( echo "Nested in USR1" & ) )'\'' USR1' (20,725 us, 4.29%)
